title: Gaussian splat renderer package integrated with a sample scene
summary: Integrate a Unity Gaussian splat renderer (MIT or compatible; aras-p UnityGaussianSplatting lineage as the candidate) pinned by commit, with a small sample splat rendering in a test scene on the reference Android device at 30 fps. The package choice is recorded as an addendum to ADR-0001 through an AUTH (design-change) filed via the Foreman.

acceptance_tests.test: Renderer package added to Packages/manifest.json by git URL pinned to a commit SHA; LICENSE file included; license is MIT/BSD/Apache-2.0.
A sample splat (≤ 10 MB, self-captured or public domain, no faces or private documents visible) renders in unity/Assets/Capture/Samples/SplatSample.unity in the Editor.
The sample scene runs on the reference Android device at ≥ 30 fps p99 over 60 s with the Profiler attached.
ADR-0001 addendum names the package, commit, license, and the fallback (textured-mesh visuals on low-end devices); the PR cites the APPROVED #n for that design change.
Splat LOD/culling knobs are exposed in a single ScriptableObject so gj-gameplay can tune them later.

auth_required.what: ADR-0001 addendum: splat renderer package choice
